one_liner: Woodworking cut-list optimizer: enter stock and parts, get an efficient cutting diagram with kerf and waste stats
target_user: hobbyist woodworkers breaking down sheet goods and lumber
core_job: enter stock sizes and part list, optimize nesting, show cutting diagram, track waste and offcuts
primary_interaction: enter parts -> optimize -> view diagram -> check off cuts -> save project
wedge_hypothesis: cut list optimizers are web forms or old desktop; a fast local mobile optimizer with project reuse is underserved
